channelTitle: Feeling a cold coming on? Grandma June's elderberry syrup
hook: Everyone around you is sniffling and you can feel it creeping up on you too? Grandma June always kept a jar of elderberry syrup ready for exactly this.
remedy: As a time-honored piece of home wisdom passed down for generations, a spoonful of elderberry syrup at the first sign of the sniffles has long been a cold-season staple in many households, valued for its deep, tart-sweet flavor and comforting ritual.
steps: Take a tablespoon of prepared elderberry syrup
Take it once or twice a day at the first sign of a cold
Pair it with plenty of rest and fluids
caution: Only use syrup made from properly cooked, ripe elderberries, raw or unripe elderberries are toxic. Check with a doctor first if you're pregnant, nursing, on immune-suppressing medication, or giving it to a young child.
cta: Does your family keep elderberry syrup on hand for cold season, or do you have a different go-to? Tell Grandma June in the comments
